title: Figma uses AI to transform digital design
summary: Discover how Figma is transforming digital design with AI. David Kossnick shares how tools like Figma Make empower teams to prototype, collaborate, and build with AI—reshaping workflows for designers, developers, and non-technical creators alike.
body: Discover how Figma is transforming digital design with AI. David Kossnick shares how tools like Figma Make empower teams to prototype, collaborate, and build with AI—reshaping workflows for designers, developers, and non-technical creators alike.
summaryZh: Figma介绍了其AI工具如何辅助设计工作流，但文章侧重于产品功能介绍，缺乏技术深度。
